_comment: ABSOLUTE PATH ON PURPOSE. ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} is NOT expanded in .mcp.json (it is injected only into hook subprocesses) — with the ${...} form node receives the literal string, exits MODULE_NOT_FOUND, and the server silently never connects, which reads as 'Claude Code ignored requiresUserInteraction'. If you moved or renamed this repo, update the path below and re-run the /mcp precondition in README.md.
